description: Builds an evidence brief for a prediction-market question (Kalshi, Polymarket or similar) from the live web: {question, as_of, summary, evidence_for, evidence_against, key_dates, resolution_notes, sources}, usually in 5 to 8 seconds. Pass the question as the market words it, including its date or threshold (for example 'by Dec 31, 2026' or 'above 4.5%'). It reports evidence and what decides resolution; it gives no probability, forecast or trading advice. Use research.answer for general questions. Read-only. Paid per call with x402; if it cannot answer in time the call fails and is not charged.

question.description: The prediction-market question to research, 1 to 500 characters, worded as the market words it.
question.title: Question

name: research.market

as_of.description: The date the brief was written, YYYY-MM-DD.

evidence_against.description: Up to 3 facts that support No.

evidence_for.description: Up to 3 facts that support Yes.

key_dates.description: Known or upcoming dates, each 'YYYY-MM-DD: what happens'.

resolution_notes.description: What usually decides resolution and what is ambiguous.

summary.description: About 50 words of evidence, not a forecast.
